purpose: Content-bound examples retained from legacy YuanForge; each case is expected to be rejected or reported as unresolved by an applicable verifier.

cases.failure: A validation runner can report PASS when no executable assertions ran.
cases.expected: Reject zero assertions and empty selection.

cases.failure: A required framework-self-test is named but no executable implementation exists.
cases.expected: Missing verifier or binding fails closed.

cases.failure: Mock-only validation appears green while the real database contract has drifted.
cases.expected: Require Evidence from the declared real or isolated environment.

cases.failure: VERSION, initializer constants, and metadata can disagree.
cases.expected: Treat .yuan/VERSION as the single source and reject drift.

cases.failure: The implementation author can weaken or replace the validation lane.
cases.expected: Use independent or held-out validation plus integrity diff.

cases.failure: Merged, deployed, and live-verified claims are collapsed into one status.
cases.expected: Require separate scoped Evidence for every claimed state.

cases.failure: Multiple independently writable status documents can disagree.
cases.expected: Keep one writable authority and make human views disposable projections.

cases.failure: A repeated strategy can continue without new evidence or a finite exit.
cases.expected: Reject same-strategy/no-new-evidence retries and honor declared budgets.

cases.failure: Framework templates and live project state are written into the same lane.
cases.expected: Keep template specifications and runtime projections separate.

cases.failure: A rewrite replaces unique examples and exceptions with a short summary.
cases.expected: Retain exact source content until clause provenance and cleanup authorization exist.
